## 📝 Description

Please include a summary of the changes made and the motivation behind them.

- **Type of Change**:
  - [ ] Bug fix (non-breaking change which fixes an issue)
  - [ ] New feature (non-breaking change which adds functionality)
  - [ ] Documentation update
  - [ ] Refactoring / Code cleanup

## 🔗 Related Issue

Fixes # (issue number, e.g. `Fixes #9`)

## 🧪 Testing Performed

Describe the testing performed to verify your changes:
- [ ] Ran `npm run lint` cleanly with 0 errors
- [ ] Ran `npm run build` cleanly with 0 errors
- [ ] Verified user flows locally (`npm run dev`)

## 🖼️ Screenshots / Media (if applicable)

If your changes involve UI or graph visual updates, please attach screenshots or a short recording here.

## 📋 Contributor Checklist

- [ ] My code follows the existing style guidelines of this project.
- [ ] I have performed a self-review of my code.
- [ ] I have commented my code where necessary, particularly in hard-to-understand areas.
- [ ] My changes generate no new warnings or errors.
- [ ] I have not committed any real API keys, passwords, or secret credentials.
